recent.text: Final: Rockets 125, Jazz 118 Sengun 43 pts, 12 rebs, 5 assts Durant 22 pts, 6 assts VanVleet 17 pts (3-6 3PT) Sensational performance from Alperen Sengun saves the Rockets on a night when they didn't have much else going on offense. Just the second 40-point game of his career.
recent.author: Will Guillory

recent.text: Fred VanVleet has been stacking up these really good performances. His efficiency is up. He's putting Alpi in great position on PnR actions. And, of course, making big shots when his team needs it down the stretch.

recent.text: I wrote a few days ago about the Rockets have so many 3-point threats they can turn to this year, which is a massive difference from where they were last season. Bogdan Bogdanovic just knocked down his second 3 of the night to put Houston up 99-91. https://t.co/ebzn2ndbdg
recent.author: Will Guillory

recent.text: Some major swings in that 3rd quarter. Rockets were up by 12, then eventually went down by 8, before regaining control and going into the 4th quarter with a 93-89 lead. Alperen Sengun remains the most dominant player on the floor. He's got 34 points, 11 rebounds and 5 assists
recent.author: Will Guillory

recent.text: End of 1st half: Rockets 63, Jazz 53 Sengun 19 pts, 7 rebs, 3 assts Durant 15 pts (3-9 FG) Thompson 8 pts, 7 rebs Rockets got off to a slow start but they really closed strong to end the 2nd quarter. Alperen Sengun and Kevin Durant have been effective throughout, but what
recent.author: Will Guillory

recent.text: Jesus Tari Eason. Ends the first half with a massive dunk. #Rockets win the 2nd quarter by 10, lead Utah 63-53. In Q2, Rockets started hitting threes (5/12), got to the line for 11 FTs and moved the ball (9 ast on 11 FG). Did not allow an OREB and got 5. Sengun+KD have 34
recent.author: Varun Shankar

recent.text: Huge first half for Alperen Sengun so far. He just knocked down two free throws to give him 19 points, 7 rebounds and 3 assists with just under 4 minutes left in the 2nd quarter. The Jazz bigs just don't have an answer for him when he catches it on the short roll.
recent.author: Will Guillory

recent.text: No bucket but that's a nice passing from Amen Thompson to Bogdan Bogdanovic off a pick and pop. Two defenders came to Bogdan, who swung to a wide open Jabari in the corner.
recent.author: Varun Shankar

recent.text: Jabari Smith just made Houston's first 3-pointer of the night with 9:41 left in the 2nd quarter. Rockets were 0-7 from deep before that shot. Sengun is getting easy buckets in the paint, but the jumpers just aren't falling for everyone else.
recent.author: Will Guillory

recent.text: End of the first: #Rockets and Jazz tied at 27. Houston D doing well overall but giving up too many OREBs. Rockets offense a bit gummed up, missed some good looks though. Şengün and Durant have 10p each.
recent.author: Varun Shankar

recent.text: With the #Rockets in semi transition, Alperen Şengün runs an inverted PNR with Durant, gets a switch onto Ace Bailey and that's easy for Şengün to get inside for a layup.
recent.author: Varun Shankar
